data.body: **[P2] Isolate worker-start failures from hook cleanup.** `Thread.start()` can raise `RuntimeError` when the process cannot create another thread. The exception escapes scheduling; although `PluginExecutor` swallows it, `on_invocation_end` then never reaches state cleanup, leaving a full `_ExecutionState` per affected ARN and queued records in the warm container. Handle startup failure inside the lane, roll back or disable the queued work and complete/degrade barriers so invocation cleanup proceeds, with a regression test that makes `Thread.start()` raise.
